newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp Thyssen Nirosta holds majority of Mexinox.
newsitem.headline: Krupp Thyssen Nirosta holds majority of Mexinox.

text.p: Krupp Thyssen Nirosta GmbH now holds a majority stake in Mexinox, Mexico's only maker of flat stainless steel products, Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp said on Wednesday.
Krupp Thyssen Nirosta, a joint venture held 60 percent by Krupp and 40 percent by Thyssen AG, said it will hold 90 percent of Mexinox within a few weeks.
It has acquired Mexinox shares held by Spanish special steel manufacturer Acerinox, which continues to hold the remaining 10 percent.

Krupp Thyssen Nirosta earlier took over one-third of Mexinox from a group of Mexican investors. An additional one-third held by Thyssen Stahl AG will be transferred to Krupp Thyssen in the next few weeks, it said.
Krupp said the stake gives Krupp access to the North and South American markets.
